'''Florence Correctional Center''' (FCC) is a medium-security prison for men in [[Florence, Arizona]], owned by [[CoreCivic]] (formally, Corrections Corporation of America). The current contracts that the company holds at this location are [[United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement]] (ICE), [[United States Marshal Service]] (USMS), and City of Mesa.
Opened in 1999, the current capacity of the facility is 1824. Roughly 550 beds are for ICE detainees <ref>{{cite web|title=Florence Correctional Center|url=http://www.cca.com/facilities/florence-correctional-center|website=Corrections Corporations of America|accessdate=29 July 2016}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.documentcloud.org/documents/3116128-2016-ODO-Inspection-Florence-Correctional-Center.html|title=2016 ODO Inspection – Florence Correctional Center AZ CCA|last=Center)|first=Jennifer Chan (National Immigrant Justice|website=www.documentcloud.org|language=en|access-date=2018-12-14}}</ref> Nearly 1234 beds are for the Marshal Service and about 80 for the City of Mesa.

In 2005, CCA contracted with the [[Alaska Department of Corrections]] to keep more than 30% of the state's inmates in FCC.  Many of these Alaskans were detainees awaiting trial.<ref>{{cite news|last1=Carroll|first1=Tony|title=Many Alaska prison inmates still being sent thousands of miles away|url=http://juneauempire.com/stories/103105/sta_20051031003.shtml|accessdate=29 July 2016|publisher=Juneau Empire|date=31 Oct 2005|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160822021644/http://juneauempire.com/stories/103105/sta_20051031003.shtml|archive-date=22 August 2016|url-status=dead}}</ref>  
In 2017, [[Mesa, Arizona|Mesa]] agreed to a three-year contract with CoreCivic to house inmates in FCC, becoming the first city in Arizona to use a private prison.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.azcentral.com/story/news/local/mesa/2017/05/23/mesa-first-arizona-city-private-jail-corecivic/337197001/|title = Mesa will be first Arizona city with private jail}}</ref>

The prison is one of [[Florence, Arizona#Prisons|several state, federal and private prisons]] in Florence.
